rows.text: Once again, you arrive at the docking bay of the Freon Mechanical Alliance. A mechanical attendant leads you up a staircase, which you notice is formed by numerous mechanical arms. You wobble as you walk on it. You keep going until you see the sign of "Interastral Peace Mechanical Branch Shopping Mall."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The scene is familiar to you... You walk up to the counter.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This is the Mechanical Branch. You can bring your good stuff here and upgrade them." The mechanical staff doesn't bother to explain too much — a signal for you to make your own choice.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You feel like punching its head... but you manage to hold the urge back.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Level up Ambergris Cheese, Casket of Inaccuracy, and Fruit of the Alien Tree.
Level up Fruit of the Alien Tree.
